noah (Partnerships): Quick update  Glassbridge just accepted our connector into their ISV catalog and listed Redwood Private as an optional addon for their managed data platform. Pilot starts next week :tada:

ivy (Sales): Great! Any pilot terms or expected node count?

noah (Partnerships): 60-day pilot, initially 20 managed nodes, with an expected expansion path to 150 if performance is good. Billing is consumption + small integration fee.

ben (Partner Success): I'll run the kickoff. Need SSO/SAML docs, enrollment snippet, and an integration checklist. Also ask Glassbridge for a 1-line quote for the listing.

elena (Engineering): Sharing a minimal enroll curl and note on ports:
`curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/enroll -H "Authorization: Bearer <ENROLL_TOKEN>" -d '{"node_id":"glass-01"}'`
We require outbound TLS to api.redwood.ai:443 and the agent listens on 8443 locally.

market-check-bot: catalog validation 2026-11-03T09:02:10Z - PASS

maria (Marketing): I'll draft a short partner blurb and a one-pager. Recommend holding external announcement until week-1 telemetry looks stable.

ivy (Sales): Marking CRM opp as "ISV Catalog Pilot - Glassbridge" and flagging AE for renewal playbook.

noah (Partnerships): Created private channel `#glassbridge-integration` and invited vendor leads. Next steps: (1) elena: full enroll + SAML template by EOD, (2) ben: schedule kickoff and capture partner quote, (3) maria: draft blurb. Thanks team! :rocket:
